Akhilesh Pillalamarri, an attorney and columnist on Asian affairs for The Diplomat, joins host Tushar Shetty to explore the rise of anti-Indian sentiment in the United States. They discuss the spillover of online anti-Indian hate into the real world, the cultural anxieties driving right-wing attacks on Indian Americans and the H-1B debate, the erosion of America’s consensus against open racism and the left’s muted response, the case for second-generation Indian Americans to speak up rather than keep their heads down, the backlash’s implications for India-U.S. ties and India’s ability to retain talent, and the parallels between anti-Indian bigotry and antisemitism.
Tushar Shetty is an Economist-in-training at HTW Berlin and host of the Beyond the Indus podcast.
